home.noGoalBody: Pick a reward — pizza night, a movie, a day out — and let the family play for it.

dev.themesSubtitle: Developer tool: every base component in every theme.

welcome.subtitle: Learn, play and reach goals together — the whole family.
welcome.joinHint: Kids and family members: ask the parent who set up Brainy Clan for your code.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in with your email and password.
login.noAccount: New here? Create a parent account

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: You'll set up your family right after.
register.birthHint: Parent accounts are for adults. We only use this to set up the right experience.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

join.title: Join your family
join.subtitle: Type the 8-character code your parent gave you.
join.withLoginHint: Optional for adult family members, so you can sign in on other devices.

createFamily.title: Create your family
createFamily.subtitle: Hi {{name}}! Name your family to get started.
createFamily.name: Family name
createFamily.timezoneHint: Daily goals end at midnight in this time zone.

family.noInvitesBody: Invite your family so you can play together.
family.limitBody: Your plan allows {{max}} members, including pending invites. Upgrade to the Family plan to add more.
family.adminOnlyHint: Only family admins can invite and edit members.
family.goalsHint: See what the family is playing for
family.goalsHintAdmin: Set targets and rewards for the family

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.subtitle: Kids just need a nickname — no email, no real name.
invite.nicknameHint: Shown to the family. Avoid full names for kids.
invite.birthHint: Used to pick age-appropriate content. Only admins can see it.
invite.howTo: On their device: open Brainy Clan, tap “Join with invite code” and type this code.
invite.shareMessage: Join our family on Brainy Clan! Open the app, tap “Join with invite code” and enter {{code}} (for {{name}}).

member.difficultyHint: Auto uses the range suggested for their age. Set a level to make questions easier or harder.
member.removeHint: They will lose access on all their devices. Their points stay in the history.

profile.appearanceNeedsFamily: Appearance settings are available once you're in a family.

goals.title: Family goals
goals.subtitle: Play together toward a reward.
goals.emptyAdmin: Create a goal with a reward to motivate the family.
goals.emptyMember: Ask a family admin to set a goal with a reward.
goals.limitBody_one: Your plan allows {{count}} active goal. Pause one, or upgrade to the Family plan for more.
goals.limitBody_other: Your plan allows {{count}} active goals. Pause one, or upgrade to the Family plan for more.

modeHelp.cooperation: Everyone's points add up. Reach the target together and the whole family wins the reward.
modeHelp.competition: Everyone plays for themselves. Whoever scores the most points by the end wins the reward.

periodHelp.daily: A fresh start every day at midnight.
periodHelp.monthly: Runs for the whole calendar month.

goals.noPointsYet: No points yet in this period. Be the first!
goals.pausedHint: This goal is paused. Points are not counted until it is resumed.
goals.deleteHint: Changes start with the next period. Deleting keeps the history.

wizard.nameHelp: Give it a name the family will love.
wizard.categoriesHelp: Points from these categories count. Picking a category includes all its topics.
wizard.targetHelpTeam: How many points should the family collect together each period?
wizard.targetHelpEach: How many points should each player aim for each period?
wizard.ownTargetHint: Smaller targets keep it fair for younger players.
wizard.rewardHelp: What does the family get? A good reward is the best motivation.
wizard.noReward: No reward set — you can still play for bragging rights.
